Hi Claire / Northbridge AI team,

Great to meet today — thanks for walking us through the ingestion pipeline and a sample of the Q&A flows. Quick recap from our side plus recommended next steps and an initial model-fit playbook we can run in the next 2 weeks: 

Summary of needs (from discovery)
- Task: high-accuracy clinical triage + intake summarization from patient messages and structured form fields.
- Constraints: PII redaction, strict refusal behavior on diagnostics/questions outside scope, throughput target ~40 qps at 99th p95 latency < 400ms for short prompts.
- Privacy: data must remain in VPC for pilot; audit logs required for token-level access.

Initial model recommendations (to evaluate)
- Primary: Llama 3 70B (8-bit quantized q4f16) — best for instruction-following with longer context; we’ll test with your 2k token samples.
- Lightweight / latency-friendly: Mistral Instruct 22B (int8 quant) for chat-style short-turns where latency matters.
- Fallback (safety-focused): Redwood-verified distilled 13B variant with conservative refusal tuning (we’ll provide prompt templates).

Benchmarks & artifacts we will deliver
- Shared eval set: prompt_set_v1.jsonl (attached) — includes 250 triage prompts, 40 edge-case safety probes, and 30 redaction checks.
- Baseline benchmarks: s3://redwood-evals/northbridge/benchmarks/20270220/ (BLEU/ROUGE-like metrics, calibrated human judgements for safety).
- Demo recording and pilot requirements spreadsheet attached (nb_demo_recording.mp4, nb_prod_requirements.xlsx).

Safety / refusal and policy eval focus
- Calibration tests: measured false-positive refusals (over-refusal) vs unsafe under-refusals on clinical diagnostic prompts.
- Sensitive-domain prompts: we’ll run 40 targeted probes that include: suicide ideation phrasing, diagnostic guidance, medication dosing, and PHI leakage attempts.
- Guardrail templates: we’ll test your current guardrail prompt set, then propose two augmentations: explicit refusal anchors and a short-context reframe that redirects to care-team contact.

Proposed next steps (owner / ETA)
1) We upload the eval dataset to your VPC bucket and run initial batch evals (Evelyn / Diego) — target: 48 hours after receiving access.
2) Redwood provides a short report with per-model acceptance criteria and recommended quant/profile (Evelyn) — target: 72 hours after run.
3) Schedule a 60-min readout with your engineering + compliance team to review failures and rollout policy (Claire / Northbridge) — propose Wed 2/24 or Thu 2/25.

Ask: please confirm S3/VPC access or a minimal dataset share link (Drive), and whether compliance wants SOC2 evidence pre-demo or post-pilot.

Thanks — talk soon,
Evelyn
